title: Smart Farm Dashboard
shortDescription: An IoT-enabled agriculture monitoring dashboard showing real-time crop statistics, soil moisture, and greenhouse controls.
description: Smart Farm Dashboard is a cutting-edge web application designed for modern precision agriculture. It reads telemetry data from distributed sensors across fields, visualizing soil moisture, environmental temperature, humidity, and NPK nutrients. It allows farmers to optimize watering schedules and crop care, drastically reducing resource wastage.
features: Real-time sensor telemetry updates via MQTT protocol
Automated automated watering & greenhouse ventilation triggers
Customizable alert threshold systems for critical values

title: KubeDeploy Navigator
shortDescription: A sleek DevOps portal and automation tool to manage Kubernetes cluster deployments, node health, and service configs.
description: KubeDeploy Navigator simplifies multi-cluster Kubernetes administration. It offers real-time node performance graphs, pod resource usage tracking, dynamic replica scaling, and visual deployment rollout monitoring. Developers can manage configs, review container logs, and inspect ingress routers without writing raw kubectl commands.
features: Live container log streaming and searching

title: Spentaru Archive System
shortDescription: A secured document archive and file repository platform designed for organizational resource management.
description: Spentaru Archive System is a high-performance web database built for secure corporate and educational archives. It provides optimized search matching, complex category collections, metadata editing, access permission groups, and activity audits. It is optimized to catalog thousands of records without degrading query speed.
features: Dynamic file collection and category folder grouping
